docsPromises.promise: Signed runner claim payloads can include storyId/jobId without schema rejection.
A live runner for story B-current sends claim.storyId=B-current and the stale queued job mismatch scenario is covered by regression evidence.
Implementation keeps selectors inside signed claim payloads; no queue purge or retry workaround is added.
Focused smokes show claim.storyId is sent for B-current and stale other-story queued jobs are not accepted as current-story success.
